source.value: Rippers Unmasked — HSC Vol.2 (Song of Spirits)

summary.value: You call upon the spirits to join you in song and reinvigorate your allies' spirits.

system.description: You call upon the spirits to join you in song and reinvigorate your allies' spirits. Until this spell ends, each target that is about to pay a Mind Point cost may halve that cost. Then, the effects of this spell ends for that target. This spell cannot be cast on a creature benefiting from the Massage Camp Activity (see Natural Fantasy Atlas, page 133), and its benefit cannot be applied to a Ritual's cost in Mind Points. This spell is treated as a verse for the purposes of Chanter Skills...
